description: Private key/value memory for an agent: remember values across calls (set/get/delete/list/exists), scoped to the paying wallet. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

limit.description: For list: max keys to return (default 100, max 500).

ttl_seconds.description: Optional expiry in seconds (default 30 days, max 90; 0 = no expiry).

value.description: Any JSON value to store (required for set).

name: agentbit.agent_memory
title: Agent Memory (KV Store)
